invented_facts: Aurora is described as having "leading AI performance" and as "outperforming" Vantage; the brief compares NPU TOPS but does not establish overall AI performance.
Aurora's upgradeable memory is said to be "protecting your investment," an outcome the brief does not substantiate.
Aurora is said to meet "typical mobile work requirements"; the brief provides no basis for that claim.
notes: The battlecard includes every requested element, stays under 350 words, and treats Vantage's advantages fairly. Remove or qualify the unsupported performance and customer-outcome claims before sending.
